global_findings: All six preserve the requested broad state contrast in some form, but this is not six validated predictions or three independently confirmed rules.
H01B ownership presupposition, H02B assurance-speaker attribution and H03A role ambiguity remain actual output defects/limits.
All cases are source-known, same-root and contrast-visible; narrative and expected-answer cueing are strong.
English outputs are polished and repeatedly procedural/witty; source voice, cultural adequacy, affective realism and ordinary transfer are not independently measured.
